id: title:Gilbert09:scope asana users requests to a workspace

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector implementation for Asana, carrying workspace GID downstream for time-tracking entries.
review.reason: Adds workspace parameter and retains workspace GID in opt_fields for Asana users API, enabling warehouse ingestion while respecting multi-workspace token constraints. This is a connector implementation change without demonstrated adoption or benefit.
review.uncertainty: No adoption, benefit, or incident avoidance demonstrated; tier assigned based on implementation of bounded capability and relevant checks, not unverified outcomes.
